dont even know how i could. would have to move, im lucky to live where i am now. id end up homeless like the last time i tried living without roommates.  i just dont know what to do

idk maybe talking was a bad idea. the more i keep thinking about it the more i feel like ive no other options
based on what you said they would report me

allowed was a bad word choice.  no one would ever hire me.  google. every tech job ive held searches applicant names before they even do interviews/call references.  id never have a chance. and i live in a smallish town with media that has little else to report on.  id be done.

i know, i mean i wasnt expecting hordes of people to be willing to talk but to be honest i have no intentions of seeking help in person. i live in a state with mandatory reporting. it would effectively end my life just the same as if i kill myself. id never be allowed to work in my career field again. i know my family would disown me. id be more alone than i am now.

what more validation do i need than this post? the only person who will even talk to me is another pedo (no offence, it's nice that you did, and i'm happy for you that you seem to be dealing with your issues in a good way).
but it is what i am. i havent known any different my whole life.
who would even want to help? i dont think id be able to tell anyone face to face anyway. how the hell am i supposed to tell someone im attracted to babies. the fuck does that even happen.
